Portfolio Statement splits properties into Investment Properties (14, Σ 2,479,867k) and Property, Plant & Equipment (9 hotels + 'Other plant and equipment', PPE Σ 873,081k). market_valuation taken from the audited Stapled Group Portfolio Statement '000 (p213-215). Per-property GR/NPI from 'Performance by Country and Property' (p28-29): 'Properties with Leases' use Gross Rental Revenue; 'Managed Properties' use Gross Hotel Revenue. Both feed gross_revenue; totals reconcile to 267,566 / 129,694.

AUDIT: 60,933 ('000) = 'Total distribution (after retention for working capital)', the FY2025 DPU numerator (DPS 4.80c), per Financial Highlights Statement of Total Return (p9). NOT 'Distribution to holders... during the year' 60,492 (which mixes prior-year periods). Correct as stored; no change.

For-the-year declared distribution = 60,933 ('000) → absolute 60,933,000, equal to net_distributable_income because that figure is itself the 'Total distribution after retention for working capital' (the disclosed 5,694 working-capital retention is already deducted upstream in the Distribution Statement build-up, p207: 56,944 − 5,694 retained + 9,683 capital distribution = 60,933). Retained check: net_distributable_income 60,933,000 − distribution_paid 60,933,000 = 0 (100% of the after-working-capital-retention distributable income declared). The report discloses only a hotel-level 'Average occupancy rate: 84.5%' (p89, FY2025 Key Financials), explicitly a hotel-room occupancy stat, combined with the retail contribution folded into the same GR/NPI line (p28 footnote 4: 'Includes contribution from retail units leased to tenants'). No separate leased/committed occupancy % is printed anywhere for the retail-units component specifically; the report states only that 'the two retail units are currently tenanted out and the existing leases will continue until 2033' (p89) with no percentage figure. Genuine structural absence, not a miss.
